name: ai-provenance (aiprov)
description: Domain-agnostic AI provenance tracking over PROV-O: agent/activity/entity classes for AI-in-the-loop work, full inference telemetry, a source verification ladder with human-only rungs, a conformance validator suitable as a CI gate, and packaging as an executable Agent Skill. Generalized from the F(AI)²R experiment.

affiliation.name: Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt (DLR)

referencePublication: F(AI)²R: Who Did What, and Who Checked? Verifiable AI Provenance as an Executable Skill (arXiv:2607.25637; sources in paper/, built by CI)
